messages:
Ivy: Quick reminder — partner sync TOMORROW 9:30am PT. We need final perf/W and throughput numbers for the marketplace listing. Also press kit + kernel patch notes. Can folks confirm status? :eyes:

Owen: Got nightly runs; kernel-0.9.2 shows ~3.1% perf/W uplift on M60 nodes, throughput stable. Will run with longer seqs tonight. Job id: bench-2026-03-20-owen

BenchBot: bench-run completed: job=bench-2026-03-20-owen status=SUCCESS duration=3h12m artifacts=/s3/bench/bench-2026-03-20-owen

Priya: For marketplace we need container tag (immutable), SHA, and a short changelog (<=150 chars). Can we get a release candidate by EOD? Also need legal check on partner logos.

Owen: Working on container tag now. Patch includes kernel flag `--kv-cache-size=1g` and the latency mitigation patch. Diff: `git diff origin/partner/main...kernel-0.9.2`

Ivy: Sam — press kit asks for two callouts: "30% lower p95 latency vs baseline" (do we have that?) and "3% perf/W improvement" — avoid exact phrasing until partner sign-off.

Sam: I have draft callouts and a quick graph screenshot. Need final p95 numbers. Can you drop an export of `p95.csv` to the shared drive? :camera:

Owen: Uploading p95.csv to /shared/bench/1747654321/p95.csv in 15m. Will also paste the key table:

``
model   p95_base  p95_patch  delta
gpt-small  120ms  114ms  -5%
llama-7b  320ms  310ms  -3%
``

Priya: That p95 delta looks conservative enough. Legal okayed the partner logo with standard attribution. I'll prepare the marketplace metadata template.

Ivy: Plan for tomorrow: 1) Owen pushes patch and container tag, 2) Priya uploads metadata, 3) Sam finalizes press kit screenshots, 4) Partner to sign-off on numbers by 5pm PT today. Anyone blocked? :thumbsup:

Owen: No blockers. Pushing tag now.

Sam: Will update assets after p95 file.

BenchBot: deploy-notify: artifact pushed tag=redwood/partner-kernel:rc-20260320

Ivy: Great — thanks everyone. I'll run the sync agenda and send calendar invite. /cc @partner-team
